info.name: MossiERP - Public Demo Requests API
info.description: Public API Collection for booking live ERP demos from the landing page (mossierp.com) with preferred demo date and 24-hr time slot. No authentication required.

item.name: Submit Demo Request (Tarika A: Date & 24-Hour Time)

body.raw:
{
  "full_name": "Vikram Sharma",
  "phone": "+91 9876543210",
  "email": "vikram@example.com",
  "company_name": "Apex Manufacturing Ltd",
  "team_size": "51-200 employees",
  "modules": [
    "CRM",
    "Sales & Order Management",
    "Inventory Management",
    "Production Management"
  ],
  "preferred_date": "2026-10-30",
  "preferred_time": "14:30",
  "notes": "Interested in complete ERP demo and enterprise pricing."
}

request.description: Submit a live demo request with preferred demo date (YYYY-MM-DD) and 24-hour time (HH:MM e.g. 14:30 for 2:30 PM). Automatically saved and formatted as AM/PM in Super Admin UI.
